routing.name: specjam-trace-to-skill
routing.description: Reconstructs an executable RWSA skill from interaction evidence.

workflow.verify: Units describe actions rather than formatting

workflow.action: Classify observations as W, S, or A
Align common steps and reconcile branches
Run coverage, consistency, and executability checks
workflow.verify: No high-priority WSA error remains or budget is exhausted

decisions: repair W for missing edges, S for vague criteria, A for missing bindings
rollback: retain the previous skill until replay validation succeeds
